---
name: Design Question
about: Request clarification from the CAD-a-thon design rookies about a mechanism or dimension
title: "[DESIGN] <Mechanism> - <short question>"
labels: ["design-question"]
assignees: []
---

## Mechanism
Which CAD-a-thon mechanism is this about? (e.g. Drivetrain D2.1, Elevator D2.2, Launcher D2.3, Intake D2.5, Swerve D2.11)

## Question
What do you need clarified from the design rookies? Be specific (dimension, sensor type, actuator ID, gear ratio, etc.).

## Why it matters
Which code / subsystem is blocked until this is answered? (e.g. `ElevatorSubsystem`, `DrivetrainSubsystem`)

## Suggested value (optional)
If you have a guess or a reasonable default, state it here so design can confirm or correct it.

## CAD reference (optional)
Link or screenshot from the CAD assembly/sketch, if available.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Design rookies have answered the question
- [ ] `constants_template.java` updated with the real value (no `// TODO` remaining for this item)
- [ ] Issue closed by design liaison
